purpose: OPS-001 isolation proof: the reviewed private trial backend migrations were applied to an isolated Supabase branch that replicates the parent project's public surface, and the deployed private schema was fingerprinted against the repository.

branch.name: security-rehearsal-24h-20260812
branch.postgresVersion: PostgreSQL 17.6 on x86_64-pc-linux-gnu, compiled by gcc (GCC) 15.2.0, 64-bit
branch.manualApplyReason: Branch creation replays the parent project's tracked migration list, which left the branch at MIGRATIONS_FAILED. The eleven reviewed private trial backend migrations were then applied in order alongside the legacy public surface, so this branch reproduces the parent project's shape rather than a private-only subset.

branchLifecycle.observation: The branch stopped answering queries and no longer appears in the parent project's branch list; the project ref returns NotFoundException. It was created 2026-08-12T09:26Z and its name declared a 24 hour window, so this is the expected end of that window rather than a fault.
branchLifecycle.consequence: Everything below records what was proven while the branch existed and stays a valid point-in-time result. It is not a statement that an isolated target is available now. The parity verifier compares the recorded digest against the digest computed locally from the reviewed migrations and never contacts the branch, so it keeps passing and cannot detect this.
branchLifecycle.toResume: The remaining OPS-001 gates — recovery and restore, private Storage denial, the server-only login role, and seeded tenant separation — need a new isolated branch, which costs money and is the founder's call.

isolation.rolesWithSchemaUsageNote: Every entry other than supermega_trial_backend is a Supabase platform or PostgreSQL predefined role. None is reachable from a browser session, and no browser-facing role is a member of any of them.
isolation.backendRoleMembersNote: No login role holds supermega_trial_backend, so no credential currently reaches the private schema. Provisioning that login user remains a founder-gated hosting step.

publicSurface.note: The legacy public tables are locked twice over: row level security is enabled on every one, none carries a policy, and neither anon nor authenticated holds any table privilege. A browser session therefore reads nothing even if it reaches PostgREST.

securityAdvisor.note: All 27 notices are the INFO-level rls_enabled_no_policy lint on the legacy public tables. That lint fires precisely because those tables are default-deny with no policy, which is the intended posture, so it is recorded rather than remediated.

remainingGates: Recovery: a backup and exact restore has not been rehearsed on this branch.
Storage: private bucket denial has not been proven against this branch.
Credentials: the server-only login role for supermega_trial_backend is not provisioned.
Tenant separation under load: no seeded multi-tenant read/write rehearsal has run against this branch.
Managed writes stay off until every gate above passes and the founder authorizes them.
